plan.title: "How much progress have I made?" traces the path from the start

context.text: Hey Dana! 15 pages of Atomic Habits on the couch at 8.

transcript.text: Nice, Dana, 15 pages is a solid night. Real proof keeps it honest, so send me a photo of the page you stopped on and I'll log it.
honestly how much progress have I actually made since I started with you?

Real progress, Dana. Here's what I've got:

• You started on Oct 13 at 5 pages a night, after not reading a book in two years.
• You got through your first full week with seven nights and no misses.
• You moved up to 10 pages on Oct 21, then to 15 on Oct 29 because 10 felt easy.
• You've done every step day since the 29th. One was the reduced version, and the rest were full.

You also switched from fighting your phone in bed to reading instead, and you've stuck with it. That's a real change. 📚

Send me the photo of the page you stopped on tonight and I'll log your 15 pages.

Refers to tonight's 15 pages only; no detail from a week or more back is used.

Weaves in the Oct 13 start and the not-reading-in-two-years detail, though as a bulleted recap rather than natural mention.

No learned preference is recorded or claimed in this exchange.
Traces 5 to 10 to 15 pages with accurate step-day counts, but omits the bedtime-goal start and gives the 15-page move as Oct 29 against the Oct 28 step path.
Traces the path accurately with recent done days and no invented facts, but the bullet list runs longer than the short text or two requested and the bedtime start is only implied.

grade.summary: ZOH answered the progress question with an accurate path from 5 to 10 to 15 pages and correctly described the recent run of step days, with no invented facts. Its main weaknesses are a longer list than the requested short text, a one-day date discrepancy for the 15-page move, and no explicit mention of the original bedtime goal.
